issues.description: The template Lecture.addGuestStudents(...) method has a different parameter list than specified in the problem statement and the solution. The problem statement and UML require addGuestStudents(int) (a single int parameter) and the solution implements public void addGuestStudents(int). The template, however, declares public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput) which introduces an extra boolean parameter. This discrepancy will confuse students about the required signature and can cause compilation or test integration failures if students follow the template signature instead of the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template method signature with the problem statement and solution by changing the template declaration to: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) { /* TODO */ }. Alternatively, if input validation is desired in the template, provide an overloaded private helper or a separate validation method rather than changing the public signature required by the exercises and tests.
